sections.description: Shoppable images and affiliate product curation for content creators.
sections.changelog:
= 0.4.31 =
* Add the shared MTT brand mark to the settings heading with local assets and reserved dimensions.

= 0.4.30 =
* Browse and select story image cards in a grid. Loading more appends stories to the grid while keeping product selection unchanged.

= 0.4.29 =
* Support choosing a story independently of product selection, with a native post dropdown and story image preview.

= 0.4.28 =
* Start the LTK post or collection chooser with the creator’s 10 newest posts in publication order, instead of trending posts. Search, direct post links, and loading older posts remain available.

= 0.4.27 =
* Allow product choosers to open with an editable story-specific source link, with optional automatic loading.

* Preserve pale lampshades on plain white product backgrounds, including tightly cropped photos. Explicit removal retries older unprotected lamp cutouts from the original.

= 0.4.27-beta.1 =
* Keep public Amazon idea-list imports available independently of API access, preserving dotted tracking tags.
* Explain the credential-free list option and offer manual affiliate-link entry when an Amazon request fails.

= 0.4.26 =
* Recognize saved products by their effective affiliate link and reuse them when adding to Shop.
* Show existing matches in the picker, block conflicting REST edits, and flag duplicate links in the native product editor.

= 0.4.25 =
* Reuse recent product chooser results within the editor to speed up repeat searches and switching sources.
* Cache provider pages for 15 minutes; keep the saved catalog browser cache to 30 seconds and clear browser results on writes.

= 0.4.24 =
* Find Amazon, LTK, and ShopMy products directly in the native Add Product screen, with manual entry, review, and undo before publishing.
* Verify imported source identities on save and preserve affiliate links, native taxonomy editing, and shared product refresh.
* Add bounded Amazon keyword search and explain Amazon catalog access failures without exposing provider response bodies.

= 0.4.23 =
* Support an optional hotspot-card exit fade through `--cs-card-exit-duration` (milliseconds, default zero), with immediate reduced-motion dismissal and safe switching between hotspots.

= 0.4.22 =
* Animate Quick View drawer padding with its height to remove the final opening and closing jump, including interrupted transitions.

= 0.4.21 =
* Allow themes to match Quick View disclosure timing and easing to their own motion styles.
* Preserve the current opacity when reversing an in-progress disclosure animation.

= 0.4.20 =
* Use a Save to Shop toggle in product details.
* Overlay Replace image on the preview for aligned columns, revealing it on hover or keyboard focus and keeping it visible on touch devices.

= 0.4.19 =
* Simplify product-image review with an Image version selector for the original and saved cutout, and move reprocessing into More image options.
* Place Replace image beside the preview heading and show progress, cancellation, and retry controls only when relevant.

= 0.4.18 =
* Reuse the product picker’s image preview, replacement, background removal and original-image controls in the Shop Product editor.
* Save product details with the native Update button while keeping categories, brands and publishing controls in WordPress.

= 0.4.17 =
* Consolidate shop organization under Shop Categories and add Brands with native editor controls.
* Provide a previewable collection migration that retains saved slider references and product relationships.

= 0.4.16 =
* Keep native checkbox and toggle focus rings visible at the product picker’s scrolling edges without shifting the form alignment.

= 0.4.15 =
* Use the native WordPress search control with its search icon and clear action in the product picker.
* Preserve live search, immediate Enter searches, and pasted-link loading without a custom embedded button.

= 0.4.14 =
* Group the product preview and image actions beside clearly labeled title/link fields, stacking on smaller screens.
* Use one background-removal spinner and one error notice; remove the duplicate progress bar and busy button.
* Clarify optional catalog saving and keep the final product action visible.
* Avoid loading source search results in the background while reviewing an existing product.

= 0.4.13 =
* Replace BiRefNet with IMG.LY IS-Net at 1024×1024 inference resolution, retaining one-click removal and editor-only processing.
* Preserve soft alpha edges, recover GPU failures in a fresh CPU worker, and keep source images intact.
* Distinguish explicit and automatic results, protect plain-background rugs, and allow legacy cutouts to be regenerated with IMG.LY.
* Include a locked, reproducible Yarn build with bundled dependency source maps and license notices.

= 0.4.12 =
* Show “Removing background…” during model loading and downloading, with no download wording or percentages in the product controls.

= 0.4.11 =
* Automatically start browser AI background removal when choosing products, including bulk selections, without delaying insertion.
* Keep background-removal progress and errors inside product controls instead of global announcements.

= 0.4.10 =
* Default the product disclosure to See all products with an inline-editable label and plus/minus indicator.
* Preview all tagged products in an editor grid when the product list is enabled.
* Style the collection Shop all link with the product-card outline button; edit its text inline and disconnect/reconnect its room URL from the toolbar.
* Use Embla 8.6.0 for free dragging with momentum, matching theme shop sliders and respecting reduced motion.

= 0.4.9 =
* Search product pickers after a 400 ms typing pause; cancel outdated searches and retain immediate Enter, Search, and pasted-link loading.

* Restore mobile crops in the editor and frontend, keeping mobile dots inside the image.
* Save mobile hotspot positions independently and preserve them when replacing products.

= 0.4.8 =
* Keep cropped-out hotspots selectable at the editor image edge, including mobile previews.
* Drag from the visible marker without jumping; preserve saved coordinates on selection and canceled drags.

= 0.4.7 =
* Remember saved cutout status for remote products across editor sessions and reuse completed images before processing.
* Preserve the authored image when reopening Shop products so the original-image toggle remains reversible.
* Verify single and bulk Save to Shop catalog promotion.

= 0.4.6 =
* Remove backgrounds and save cutouts from one click, without a preview modal or acceptance step.
* Show inline progress stages and download percentages without repeating the first-use warning.
* Continue jobs when product details close, prevent duplicate requests, and retain original-image recovery.

= 0.4.5 =
* Allow manual background removal for every product image source, including Amazon-hosted images and overrides.
* Start browser AI previews on click for detailed backgrounds, with cancellation and explicit saving.
* Display saved remote cutouts and keep original-image recovery available.

= 0.4.4 =
* Show each fetched page immediately with one Load more products action across sources.
* Show every selected product in review and hide unrelated search controls there.

= 0.4.3 =
* Keep image-preview instructions focused on editing and saving.

= 0.4.2 =
* Replace browser AI with plain-background removal in automatic and manual workflows; no model download or external service.
* Keep original images and reject previews without a clear background or visible product.

= 0.4.1 =
* Simplify background-removal instructions and use a compact preview dialog.
* Keep product titles inside consistently sized cards, including selection review.
* Decode imported title punctuation and restore the Save to Shop toggle.
* Use a light media-library selection state with a square check indicator.

= 0.4.0 =
* Import public Amazon idea lists with on-demand paging and preserved affiliate links, without requiring API credentials.
* Unify source searches, add product editing in bulk mode, expose partial selection, and retain selections across sources with a dedicated review view.
* Make background removal repeatable from the original, including uploaded Amazon product photos, and restore native media selection outside the block editor.
* Avoid speculative provider requests, coalesce duplicate imports, cache failures, and respect provider cooldowns.
* Preserve authored affiliate links when cached provider data refreshes.

= 0.3.8 =
* Accept AVIF product sources and normalize oversized uploads without overwriting original attachments.
* Share a reusable AI worker across product editing surfaces, with GPU-to-CPU recovery and cancellation.
* Identify failed products, provide retry and remote review controls, and defer repeated failures across editor reloads.
* Prevent duplicate imports and automatic saves; reject effectively empty automatic cutouts.

= 0.3.7 =
* Keep Shop Collections taxonomy in the plugin so product organization survives theme changes.
* Show the resolved product image or selected cutout in the Shop Products dashboard list without provider requests.

= 0.3.6 =
* Use Shop Products / Product labels and the MTT dashboard logo.
* Restore explicit Save to Shop for single and bulk picker integrations, retaining shared product references.

= 0.3.5 =
* Return product selections without waiting for automatic cutouts; originals remain usable while the editor processes images.
* Keep lifestyle scenes, colored backgrounds and existing transparency unchanged during automatic processing, using a conservative near-white border check.
* Follow bounded safe image redirects, resize supported remote sources up to 20 MB / 24 megapixels, and report download, format and size failures separately.

= 0.3.4 =
* Preserve rugs, carpets, and floor mats with automatic protected background removal; stop displaying older unprotected cutouts for these products.
* Keep the original backdrop where its boundary cannot be identified safely, rather than erase the product.

= 0.3.3 =
* Automatically prepare, remove, and save product backgrounds through the shared editor API, including bulk selections and existing block images.
* Reuse cutouts across blocks, process one image at a time, preserve originals on failure, and remove the manual preparation step.

= 0.3.2 =
* Keep source tabs available while creating or editing products in the shared picker.
* Show one recent LTK story and a bounded product grid with compact titles and a separate selection footer.
* Support a caller-defined picker title and initial source for the story workflow.

= 0.3.1 =
* Added opt-in bulk selection to the shared product picker, including all displayed products from an LTK post and its story image.
* Added a no-shop mode so client blocks can keep product edits local without creating or changing shared Shop Items.

= 0.3.0 =
* Add free browser AI cutouts for white, black, and other backdrops, with review before saving, enclosed-detail protection for artwork, cancellation, and original recovery.
* Reuse reviewed cutouts across product images without adding AI downloads or processing to visitor pages.

= 0.2.6 =
* Add a per-image Show Shop this room toggle, enabled by default. Hiding the slider preserves hotspot popups, caption links, and no-JavaScript product links.

= 0.2.5 =
* Link room titles to their configured destination, remove the recent-post dropdown, and enforce original image proportions across desktop and mobile.

= 0.2.4 =
* Fade the active image hotspot out while its popup is open, restoring it on close and avoiding duplicate numbers.

= 0.2.3 =
* Use white product tiles with a theme-controlled darker hover background and remove slider arrows while retaining drag, swipe, and keyboard scrolling.

= 0.2.2 =
* Render square image-only shopping tiles with direct image links and no overlaid CTA. Keep popup details in inert templates and Shop more outside the image track.

= 0.2.1 =
* Anchor popup numbers consistently and add animated, draggable image-only room shopping strips with hidden scrollbars.
* Reuse explicitly processed remote-image cutouts in existing hotspots while preserving originals and authored page content.

= 0.2.0 =
* Refined click-open product cards, subtle hover beacons, and responsive caption-row product sliders with editable Shop more destinations.
* Replaced paid background removal with free local white-background cutouts, safe product-image imports, original recovery, and bounded deferred jobs.

= 0.1.14 =
* Open existing hotspots on their product details, with Back returning to the retained picker. Shared Shop Item edits use WordPress REST permissions and retain the catalog reference.

= 0.1.13 =
* Automatically load pasted LTK links and keep imported product titles empty when cleared for editing.

= 0.1.12 =
* Remember the picker source, search/link, selected collection, and loaded results separately for each image while editing. Reopening for another hotspot clears only the chosen product; Back updates the retained browsing context.

= 0.1.11 =
* Added a Core-style grab handle to each hotspot toolbar, sharing direct-drag positioning and cancellation behavior.

= 0.1.10 =
* Removed the redundant product controls below the editor image. Hotspot actions remain in their contextual toolbar; crop and image-review notices use the sidebar.

= 0.1.9 =
* Use the native WordPress focal-point picker for image crops, preserving existing crop positions.

= 0.1.8 =
* Removed the redundant Add product at center button; new hotspots use the toolbar placement action.

= 0.1.7 =
* Added a contextual hotspot toolbar for product replacement/removal and improved drag selection and grab offsets. Removed arrow-key positioning to avoid editor navigation conflicts.

= 0.1.6 =
* Added five recent LTK post shortcuts below search, saved separately for each editor and creator account.

= 0.1.5 =
* Replaced the large LTK search button with an accessible icon inside the search input.

= 0.1.4 =
* Show Load more only for confirmed new results; stop empty, repeated, and exhausted pages and deduplicate appended products.

= 0.1.3 =
* Show creator trending posts first and surface matching products in keyword searches. Selecting a post loads all its tagged products independently.

= 0.1.2 =
* Added creator-scoped LTK keyword search and direct post URL lookup with ownership validation.

= 0.1.1 =
* Fixed Back navigation from Create Item, separated picker actions, and clarified block-only products.

= 0.1.0 =
* Introduced shoppable image editing, selective creator imports, and optional product cutouts.
